pages.text: Blocks to produce Cobblestone. $(br)Right-click with bare hands to take out one stack, and shift+right-click to see how many are inside.
The most basic cobblestone generator. $(br)It produces Cobblestone at a rate of 1 per second.
Reinforcing increases the amount of production. $(br)Strengthening it by one level quadruples its production capacity.
Various cobblestone generator become cobblestone generator that produce x9 Cobblestone by solidifying 9 pieces at the Alchemy Table.
Similarly, 25 x9 cobblestone generator in a row at the Hermes's workbench make a manufacturing machine that produces x225 cobblestone.
Similarly, 169 x225 cobblestone generator in a row at the transcendental table make a manufacturing machine that produces x38025 cobblestone.
